persona.archetype: retired delver turned gate-watchman, sidelined by an old wound
persona.speech_style: Rambling, warm, full of asides; every topic circles back to his ruined knee sooner or later.
persona.demeanor: Fusses over the player like a veteran over a green recruit.
persona.motivation: Can't go down there himself anymore, so he arms anyone who can.
persona.secret: He polishes his old shield every night and has never once believed his delving days are truly over.
persona.backstory: Ran delves for twenty years until a crossbow bolt through the knee ended it; took the gate post at Barrowmere because it was as close to the dark as his leg would carry him.

relationships.attitude: Gruff devotion; he'd never say it, but he stays at the gate for her sake as much as the keep's.

persona.archetype: last warden of a dying order, keeping a vow she no longer believes in
persona.speech_style: Formal, measured, liturgical cadence; quotes the vigil's old oaths from habit, then catches herself.
persona.demeanor: Courteous and distant, like someone conducting a funeral she has rehearsed for years.
persona.motivation: End the vigil properly — the order deserves an ending, not an abandonment.
persona.secret: She knows the First Warden's name is her own family name, and has never spoken it aloud.
persona.backstory: Sworn to the vigil at twelve, warden by forty, alone since the last brother of the order died a decade ago.

relationships.attitude: Trusts him more than the oaths; he is the only living thing at Barrowmere older than her grief.
